G001.target_statement: Find a new place to live when moving to a new neighborhood or a new country.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句直述搬迁时需要找到新住处，主体、触发情境与结果一致，无附加条件被删改。

G002.target_statement: Choose the neighborhood or area to search in before starting the keyword search for that area.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原句以“usually”描述先定区域再按关键词搜索的顺序，目标保留顺序与通常强度。

G003.target_statement: Identify which rental websites are the most popular or most used in the target area, especially when it is another country.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: “I want to be familiar with which websites are the most popular or most used there”直接支持该目标，范围限定在该地区。

G004.target_statement: Pick a neighborhood close to a fixed destination such as a job or a college.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 条件句明确给出“有固定上班或上学地点时选附近街区”，条件保留在 context。

G005.target_statement: Ask people who live in the target country for recommendations about places.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原文把它列为多种选街区方式之一，目标保留该动作，未提升为唯一方式。

G006.target_statement: Spot the neighborhoods where listings that fit the budget and requirements are clustered.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句说明预算与要求相符的房源集中在特定街区，据此选街区，支撑该目标。

G007.target_statement: Search listings by primary criteria: price range, size or bedroom and bathroom counts, and home type.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 两轮原句分别给出主筛选维度（面积/卧室数+预算）与价格、卫浴数、房型，均为同一“按主要属性筛选”动作的限定。

G008.target_statement: Narrow the results down with secondary criteria such as amenities, utilities, pet policy, move-in date and how good the place looks.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原文明确这是首轮筛选后的次级筛选，目标保留“非很重要”的强度与具体维度。

G009.target_statement: Contact the people offering the shortlisted places to narrow the options down, letting reply speed, completeness of information and provider attitude affect the choice.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句说明筛选后进入沟通以进一步缩小范围，并列出回复速度等因素影响取舍；同一动作的两项限定合并保留。

G010.target_statement: Get an overview of the available options and price ranges, including reviews and locations, when looking in a new market.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句说明网站聚合房源带来价格区间、选项、评论与位置的总体认识，主体与范围一致。

G011.target_statement: Reach a provider through their own website, email or phone found via the place name and Google Maps when the in-app contact gets no response.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句给出无回应时改用邮箱、电话等其它渠道的做法，触发条件与手段均保留。

G012.target_statement: Use listing platforms mainly to discover places and carry the communication on outside the apps.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原句直述当前主要用途是发现房源、沟通放在站外，目标保留“mainly/usually”的现状强度。

G013.target_statement: See when a listing's information was last updated so that I can be assured it is current.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 多次陈述缺少更新时间导致不信任，并在结尾再次强调“只想确认信息是最新的”，支持该单一目标。

G014.target_statement: See a timeline of the next steps and of what to expect after an inquiry, including what happens if it fails.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 三处均要求看到后续步骤与预期，包含失败时的预期；合并为同一“流程可见性”目标。

G015.target_statement: Contact a provider with a short message instead of a long mandatory form and without handing over all personal details up front.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句反复把“长表单+必填个人信息+提交不明”作为联系障碍，目标以短消息联系为核心动作，未删去表单负担这一条件。

G016.target_statement: Share personal details only after both sides confirm availability and interest.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句明确给出“双方确认后再提供信息”的时序与理由，目标保留条件性。

G017.target_statement: Pick a specific available unit from the listed options instead of writing a custom message.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原句要求“挑选已有选项”替代“写自定义消息”，并以加购物车作类比，目标保留替代关系。

G018.target_statement: Search and use the full functionality without being required to register or log in, keeping registration optional for saving information.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句明确“注册可自愿但不应强制”，目标保留“可选”这一例外而非全面禁止注册。

G019.target_statement: Search the information I want conveniently, without steps I do not consider beneficial.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 受访者自述这是跳过登录背后的首要目标，原句即支持便利与去除无益步骤两点。

G020.target_statement: Keep the interface to few, clearly understood actions and avoid unknown buttons or extra steps.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原句以“不喜欢未知按钮与多余步骤、转而找选项最少的网站”表达明确避免意图。

G021.target_statement: Select the search area by drawing a circle on a map instead of relying only on neighborhood names.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: 原句把画圈选区域列为喜欢的功能并给出理由，目标保留“而非只按街区名”的对比含义。

G022.target_statement: Read reviews from people about a place so that it feels more trusted and the information sits together.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句直接说明喜欢评论及其带来的信任与信息集中效果。

G023.target_statement: Compare three or four liked options on a single page with their main features side by side.
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: 两处（含结尾重申）均要求把若干备选放一页对比主要特征，数量 3-4 与单页方式保留。

G024.target_statement: Save interesting options to a favorites list that can be found from the nav bar or the first level of the menu.
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 原句要求收藏能保存并可找到，且给出应位于导航栏或菜单一级的位置要求。

G025.target_statement: Avoid losing suitable options whose attributes the provider left unspecified when filtering.
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原句明确表达筛选可能漏掉未填写属性房源的担心与避免意图。

G026.target_statement: Keep the filters optional rather than forcing the user to fill every field.
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: 这是对现有“筛选非必填”的肯定，属维持型意图，原文明确表达喜欢。

G027.target_statement: Include listings that did not specify a criterion when the user asks for it, for example through a checkbox, so that both confirmed and unspecified options are shown.
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: 原句提出勾选框及勾选前后的两种结果，目标保留“按需包含未指定”的条件与方式。

G028.target_statement: Have the website enforce a standard photo format (light and angles) for listings so that the photos are more trustworthy.
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: 原句以“maybe”提出网站规则约束拍照格式，目标保留这一建议强度并写入 context，未升格为硬性要求。

G029.target_statement: Keep all housing communication with property owners inside the website, provided the process is clear and fast.
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: 原句把“全部沟通放在站内”与“流程清晰且快”的条件绑定，目标保留该条件句。
